source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Επιτάκιος και Βασίλειος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The life page carries two men under two head lines, «Αγιος Επιτακιος» and «Αγιος Βασιλειος», so this is a company of two named men and therefore two folders. The page says he is reckoned the first bishop of Tui in Spanish Galicia and that both fell asleep in peace; it gives no year for him beyond the century. The corpus keeps no Epitacius. No hymn, no relics.
